local data={
	--  Minerals
	["Carbon"]={name="Carbon", tier=2, use="Carbon captured from refinery incineration of plant matter. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="During the war, Endfield Industries managed to optimize their waste emission carbon capture technology.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Origocrust"]={name="Origocrust", tier=2, use="Crystalline crust acquired by delamination of Originium. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="The thickness of the crystalline crust encasing an Originium formation (referred to as Origocrust) is often used to determine the age of the Originium vein.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Amethyst Fiber"]={name="Amethyst Fiber", tier=2, use="Fibers made by refining Amethyst Ore. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="Factory-drawn Amethyst fibers exhibit vastly increased strength.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Ferrium"]={name="Ferrium", tier=2, use="A metallic ingot made by refining Ferrium Ore. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="A metal of Talos-II that is remarkably similar to Oriron. No one could explain the similarity.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Xiranite"]={name="Xiranite", tier=2, use="A material produced by a specialized facility. Can be used for repairing special facilities or for trading with various outposts.", desc="A novel Originium-based material acquired by fusing the mineral with Feranmut power. This material fuels life and prosperity in Wuling.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cuprium"]={name="Cuprium", tier=2, use="A metallic ingot made by refining Cuprium Ore. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Smelted Cuprium is no longer soft nor prone to oxidation.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	-- Powders
	["Originium Powder"]={name="Originium Powder", tier=2, use="A stabilized form of powdered Originium. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Endfield made use of Techno-Protocol to create a stable form of Originium Powder.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Carbon Powder"]={name="Carbon Powder", tier=2, use="Powdered form of Carbon. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Carbon can be shredded to yield a powdered product.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Origocrust Powder"]={name="Origocrust Powder", tier=2, use="Powdered form of Origocrust. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Origocrust can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Amethyst Powder"]={name="Amethyst Powder", tier=2, use="Shredded and powdered Amethyst Fibers. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="Amethyst can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Ferrium Powder"]={name="Ferrium Powder", tier=2, use="Shredded and powdered Ferrium. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="Ferrium can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cuprium Powder"]={name="Cuprium Powder", tier=2, use="Shredded and powdered Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="Products made using shredded Cuprium yield a more homogenized texture.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Sandleaf Powder"]={name="Sandleaf Powder", tier=2, use="Powdered Sandleaf. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Shredding releases the abrasive grit from sandleaf tissues for industrial use.", obtain="Process Sandleaves with AIC facilities"},
	["Aketine Powder"]={name="Aketine Powder", tier=2, use="Powdered form of Aketine. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="It is easier to extract target materials and substances from shredded Aketine.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Glowbug Powder"]={name="Glowbug Powder", tier=3, use="Powdered preparation of Glowbugs. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="The powdered exoskeleton of Glowbugs can still give off a gentle glow.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Scorchbug Powder"]={name="Scorchbug Powder", tier=4, use="Powdered preparation of Scorchbugs. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="The powdered exoskeleton of Scorchbugs can still give off a gentle glow. NOTE: Monitor facility temperature during processing.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Dense Originium Powder"]={name="Dense Originium Powder", tier=3, use="Acquired by grinding Originium Powder. This stable material can be used to produce other items.", desc="The UWST Originium cultivation project initially attempted \"powder seeding\" but the resulting crystal clusters would often lose their activity quickly.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Dense Carbon Powder"]={name="Dense Carbon Powder", tier=3, use="Acquired by grinding Carbon Powder. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Techno-Protocol grinding is used to create this uniquely fine powdered preparation of Carbon.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Dense Origocrust Powder"]={name="Dense Origocrust Powder", tier=3, use="Acquired by grinding Origocrust Powder. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Techno-Protocol grinding is used to prepare this dense powdered form of Origocrust with particles almost invisible to the unaided eye.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cryston Powder"]={name="Cryston Powder", tier=3, use="Acquired by grinding Amethyst Powder. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this Cryston preparation. The container of this material must be properly sealed to prevent \"flowing and leaking\" of the powdered Cryston.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Dense Ferrium Powder"]={name="Dense Ferrium Powder", tier=3, use="Acquired by grinding Ferrium Powder. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this preparation of dense Ferrium powder. It is extremely popular amongst traditional artists.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Ground Buckflower Powder"]={name="Ground Buckflower Powder", tier=3, use="Acquired by grinding Buckflower Powder. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this buckflower preparation with \"strangely\" improved pharmaceutical activity.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Ground Citrome Powder"]={name="Ground Citrome Powder", tier=3, use="Acquired by grinding Citrome Powder. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this Citrome preparation with an extremely bitter taste.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	-- Industrial Items
	["Stabilized Carbon"]={name="Stabilized Carbon", tier=3, use="An advanced material prepared by refining Dense Carbon Powder. Can be used to make other materials.", desc="Multiple processing steps have achieved a delicate balance for this brick of elemental carbon.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Packed Origocrust"]={name="Packed Origocrust", tier=3, use="A high quality material prepared by refining Dense Origocrust Powder. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="The Packed Origocrust is a result of multiple processing steps and looks just like a piece of precious \"gemstone\".", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cryston Fiber"]={name="Cryston Fiber", tier=3, use="A high quality material prepared by refining Cryston Powder. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="Cryston Fibers can undergo various processing steps to create a material for transmitting data and communication signals.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Steel"]={name="Steel", tier=3, use="A high quality material prepared by refining Dense Ferrium Powder. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="Steel manufactured by Endfield Industries has been subject to multiple processing steps. It has been included in the list of Grade 2 Reference Materials in the Talos-II Blight Resistance Standards of Industrial Metals.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Xircon"]={name="Xircon", tier=3, use="Acquired via crystal precipitation. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Introducing metallic elements has completely disrupted the balance between Originium and Feranmut power as well as the physical properties of the material itself. The Xircon crystals precipitated from the resulting effluent exhibit gemstone-like textures.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Heavy Xiranite"]={name="Heavy Xiranite", tier=3, use="A material produced by a specialized facility. Can be used for repairing special facilities or for trading with various outposts.", desc="Heavy Xiranite was first discovered in an attempt to improve Xiranite yield. During the test, the Tianshi experimented with various Xiranite polymorphic mixtures and achieved a type of dynamic-static co-equilibrium. Though the test failed to achieve its aim, it yielded a form of Xiranite with a small yet significant improvement to durability.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Hetonite"]={name="Hetonite", tier=3, use="Hetonite is acquired via replacement-precipitation. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="A novel material that sparkles and gleams. The Tianshi have great hopes for this metal and thus named it Hetonite (literal meaning: bright red cuprium). Perhaps they caught a glimpse of hope for humanity within the flaming, crimson hues.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Bumper-Rich"]={name="Bumper-Rich", tier=3, use="A fertilizer made by mixing burdo-muck with Liquid Xiranite. Can be used to fertilize a planting plot during the growth phase to increase its harvest yield.", desc="Processed burdo-muck fertilizer. Can be used to fertilize planting plots. \"Plop a bar of Bumper-Rich to your beautiful fields! Who'd say no to 88 tons per acre yield?\"", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Pyrrolite"]={name="Pyrrolite", tier=3, use="A solid piece of metal acquired by transmuting Pyrrolite Gas at the Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Like Hetonite, this metal has been highlighted for its industrial and manufacturing potential. The Tianshi called it Pyrrolite based on the word \"pyrrhos\" with the hope that the metal could generate intense heat and give birth to humanity's passion for building a new future.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Separator Core"]={name="Separator Core", tier=3, use="A filter device. Can be used to purify gaseous materials.", desc="The engineers are currently trying to upgrade facility-grade filter modules. Once the Separator Cores can be recycled and reused, the cost in industrial materials will be greatly reduced.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Bumper-Speed"]={name="Bumper-Speed", tier=4, use="A fertilizer. Can be used to fertilize a planting plot during the growth phase to shorten its growth phase.", desc="A brand new Bumper-Rich formula with rebalanced burdo-muck content. It can significantly accelerate crop growth.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Bumper-Supreme"]={name="Bumper-Supreme", tier=5, use="A fertilizer. Can be used to fertilize a planting plot during the growth phase to really shorten crop growth phase and greatly boost crop yield.", desc="A brand new Bumper-Rich formula. Every drop of bumper gold is the hard work of the Bumper staff. You are just one sack of Bumper-Supreme away from becoming THE Farmer-Supreme.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Pingtuber Leaf Powder"]={name="Pingtuber Leaf Powder", tier=2, use="Powderized form of Pingtuber Leaf. Can be used to prepare other materials. Typical product: Yummy Feed.", desc="Powderized form of Pingtuber Leaf is an excellent material for making beast feed.", obtain="Shredding Unit"},
	["Ballpea Pod Powder"]={name="Ballpea Pod Powder", tier=3, use="Powderized form of Ballpea Pod. Can be used to prepare other materials. Typical product: Double-Yummy Feed.", desc="Powderized form of Ballpea Pod. It has a mild sweet flavor of freshly cut grass. They say it has a calming effect when fed to beasts.", obtain="Shredding Unit"},
	["Yummy Feed"]={name="Yummy Feed", tier=3, use="A product of AIC processing. Feed can be used to feed beasts raised at Yuanyuan Manor Backyard to improve their Satiety. Beasts will continuously yield products when their Satiety is higher than ZERO.", desc="\"Gets them fully stuffed in two chomps?! We should call it Stuffy Feed. It makes them stuffed.\" \"I got a feeling that it's not Yummy at all.\"", obtain="Reactor Crucible, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Double-Yummy Feed"]={name="Double-Yummy Feed", tier=4, use="A product of AIC processing. Beasts raised at Yuanyuan Manor Backyard can be fed with beast feed to improve both their Satiety and Happiness. Beasts will continuously yield quality products when both their Satiety and Happiness are higher than ZERO.", desc="\"There. Brand new formula. The beasts should no longer complain about the taste.\" \"Interesting. I'll have two bites as well.\"", obtain="Reactor Crucible, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	-- Inn Products
	["Flour"]={name="Flour", tier=2, use="A product of AIC Factory processing. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="Flour is acquired by processing Reed Rye. It is as fine as snow and yields quite a chewy dough.", obtain="Shredding Unit, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Ingredients Crate"},
	["Ground Pepper"]={name="Ground Pepper", tier=2, use="A product of AIC Factory processing. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="Ground Pepper is acquired by processing Tartpeppers. A whiff of Ground Pepper, even from a distance, can make one sneeze.", obtain="Shredding Unit, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Ingredients Crate"},
	["Starch"]={name="Starch", tier=2, use="A product of AIC Factory processing. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="Starch is acquired by processing Pingtubers. It tastes pretty good, even when eaten raw.", obtain="Shredding Unit, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Ingredients Crate"},
	["Sugar"]={name="Sugar", tier=3, use="A product of AIC Factory processing. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="Sugar is acquired by processing Crunchcane. Just a little can add quite a bit of sweetness.", obtain="Shredding Unit, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Ingredients Crate"},
	["Seed Oil"]={name="Seed Oil", tier=3, use="A product of AIC Factory processing. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="Seed Oil is acquired by processing Oilseed Bloom. Essential in all sorts of skilleting, stir frying, and deep frying.", obtain="Reactor Crucible, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Ingredients Crate"},
	["Spice Mix 130"]={name="Spice Mix 130", tier=5, use="Purchasable from Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\". Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="A mix of various finely-ground spices. Rumors say that Spice Mix 1300 is in development.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Ingredients Crate"},
	-- Bottles
	["Amethyst Bottle"]={name="Amethyst Bottle", tier=2, use="A bottle made by processing Amethyst Fibers. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Amethyst bottles are being phased out from markets in the Civilization Band due to its fragility, weight, and Blight resistance.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cryston Bottle"]={name="Cryston Bottle", tier=3, use="A metallic bottle made by processing Cryston Fibers. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="Special chemical reagents can only be properly stored with Cryston Bottles. An example would be the notorious aqua mordax, otherwise known as the \"corroding water\" or localized ferric chloride solvent.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Ferrium Bottle"]={name="Ferrium Bottle", tier=2, use="A metallic bottle made by processing Ferrium. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="A metallic bottle rarely seen in the market. Although ferrium metal offers better resistance against oxidation, people still prefer the steel variant.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Steel Bottle"]={name="Steel Bottle", tier=3, use="A metallic bottle made by moulding Steel. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="A bottle made of steel, the most common of its kind in the market.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cuprium Bottle"]={name="Cuprium Bottle", tier=3, use="A metallic bottle made by processing Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for filling fluids.", desc="Cuprium bottles are pretty rare in the market because Cuprium is a more expensive metal than Ferrium.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Hetonite Bottle"]={name="Hetonite Bottle", tier=3, use="A metallic bottle made by moulding Hetonite. Can be used to produce other items.", desc="A metallic bottle that is hardly available on the market. Hetonite has a hue so alluring that even a common Hetonite bottle is considered a collector item for many people.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	-- Canisters
	["Cuprium Canister"]={name="Cuprium Canister", tier=3, use="A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.", desc="An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	-- Liquids
	["Jincao Solution"]={name="Jincao Solution", tier=3, use="A solution of Jincao. It can be processed and used for producing medicine.", desc="A solution prepared to maximize the effects of jincao extract.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Yazhen Solution"]={name="Yazhen Solution", tier=3, use="A solution of Yazhen. It can be processed and used for producing medicine.", desc="A solution prepared to maximize the effects of yazhen extract.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Liquid Xiranite"]={name="Liquid Xiranite", tier=3, use="Xiranite dissolved in Clean Water. Can be used to produce other materials. Often filled in containers and loaded on jet drones for Liquid Xiranite spraying and elimination of Active Blight in Wuling.", desc="When people first hear about aqueous Xiranite solutions, most would regard its production as a simple process. However, a user without proper equipment nor techniques would only arrive at a useless product — one that is hardly any different than sand mixed in water.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Xircon Effluent"]={name="Xircon Effluent", tier=3, use="A solution acquired by chemically reacting Liquid Xiranite with Sewage. It can be used to produce other materials, or processed at the Water Treatment Unit to render it harmless.", desc="Xircon Effluent is a form of partially inactivated Liquid Xiranite, but a fraction of its constituents remains in a hyperactive state. Energy of the Originium constituents within Liquid Xiranite gradually dissipates during various applications. This \"desiccation\" process would occasionally trigger the activation of Feranmut power within the Xiranite.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Inert Xircon Effluent"]={name="Inert Xircon Effluent", tier=3, use="A solution acquired by chemically reacting Liquid Xiranite with Sewage. It must be processed at the Water Treatment Unit to render it harmless.", desc="A type of Xircon Effluent from various applications that completely exhausted the energy of its Originium constituents. Only a minute fraction of Feranmut power has entered an active state. Such effluents can largely be regarded as chemically inert.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Sewage"]={name="Sewage", tier=3, use="Sewage is basically water with all sorts of suspended and/or dissolved materials. It must be processed at a Water Treatment Unit to render it harmless.", desc="Sewage and polluted bodies of water found in the wildlands often contain a plethora of contaminants. Advanced technology is required to clean them properly.", obtain=""},
	["Precipitation Acid"]={name="Precipitation Acid", tier=1, use="Precipitation Acid is capable of dissolving various chemically resistant materials. It has plenty of uses in the AIC Factory.", desc="Aggeloid remains would turn into a corrosive fluid when subject to abnormal levels of heat and pressure. In the process of Aggeloid formation, Ankhors would simply (and violently) \"mash\" the constituent inorganic materials of an Aggelos together to precipitate various reactions otherwise impossible in the real world. When Aggeloid remains are broken down, these unusual inorganic materials would undergo further changes. This is how the Precipitation Acid is made.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Liquid Heavy Xiranite"]={name="Liquid Heavy Xiranite", tier=3, use="Heavy Xiranite dissolved in Precipitation Acid. Can be used to produce other materials. Often filled in containers and loaded on jet drones for Liquid Heavy Xiranite spraying and elimination of Active Blight in Wuling.", desc="In addition to countering the Blight, another key focus of Xiranite tech research is the identification of potential Xiranite compounds with other materials.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cuprium Solution"]={name="Cuprium Solution", tier=3, use="A solution of materials dissolved in Precipitation Acid. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="\"I wish to head north and drill a well in the tundra, brother. The watering hole might be the very first human-dug well on Talos-II. We probably won't get anything drinkable out of it, but the water might look pretty, at least.\"", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Hetonite Solution"]={name="Hetonite Solution", tier=3, use="A solution acquired by refining the Cuprium Solution. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="The Ankhors would attract metallic ions from the depths of the Hongshan Crater Lake to assemble the Aggeloi. These beings would then be subject to various steps of \"forging\" to achieve better performances. The Tianshi of Wuling have now mastered this process to achieve large-scale metal precipitation.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	-- Gases
	["Aquagen"]={name="Aquagen", tier=2, use="The gaseous state of Clean Water. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="\"Since the great tide burst and roared, clean rippling waters disappeared, only to be replenished by the cycle of rain and vapor.\"", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Acridgen"]={name="Acridgen", tier=2, use="The gaseous state of Precipitation Acid. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="When transmuting Precipitation Acid, scientists accidentally discovered numerous properties atypical of other acidic materials. \"Activity levels look a bit off, but don't worry... I don't think they'll turn back into the Aggeloi...\"", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Heavy Xiragen"]={name="Heavy Xiragen", tier=3, use="The gaseous state of Heavy Xiranite. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="To protect the innate \"dynamic equilibrium\" of Heavy Xiranite during the transmutation process, the engineers furnished the instruments with additional real-time monitoring and modulating modules.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cuprium Gas"]={name="Cuprium Gas", tier=3, use="The gaseous state of Cuprium. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="PPE must be properly worn when operating the Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit. Do not be misled by the innocuous-looking red vapors. They can set a person's soul on fire.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Hetonite Gas"]={name="Hetonite Gas", tier=3, use="The gaseous state of Hetonite. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="When the metal was transmuted into vapors that bore a far more intense and brilliant hue of red, several lines of data danced upon the test monitoring the log. The Tianshi studied them and saw the theoretical potential for creating Pyrrolite.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Pyrrolite Gas"]={name="Pyrrolite Gas", tier=4, use="The gaseous state of Pyrrolite. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="A number of scientists believe that Pyrrolite Gas can be weaponized. Gently unleash it and watch the enemy downwind disintegrate at a visible rate.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	-- Batteries
	["LC Valley Battery"]={name="LC Valley Battery", tier=3, use="A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.", desc="Use and handle with care. Contents are hazardous to health. Compromising casing integrity may cause the said contents to leak.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["SC Valley Battery"]={name="SC Valley Battery", tier=3, use="A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.", desc="A skilled artisan can easily convert a standard capacity (SC) battery into an improvised explosive weapon.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["HC Valley Battery"]={name="HC Valley Battery", tier=4, use="A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.", desc="Many wildlands settlers make a living by stripping waste batteries of recyclable materials.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["LC Wuling Battery"]={name="LC Wuling Battery", tier=4, use="A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.", desc="Xiranite Power is a key project jointly pursued by Wuling and Endfield Industries.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["SC Wuling Battery"]={name="SC Wuling Battery", tier=4, use="A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.", desc="The biggest advantage offered by this battery is zero risks of spontaneous combustion.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	-- Parts
	["Amethyst Part"]={name="Amethyst Part", tier=2, use="A device part made by processing Amethyst Fibers. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.", desc="An Amethyst part with a wide range of uses.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cryston Part"]={name="Cryston Part", tier=3, use="A device part made by processing Cryston Fibers. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.", desc="A Cryston Part with a wide range of uses.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Ferrium Part"]={name="Ferrium Part", tier=2, use="A device part made by processing Ferrium. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.", desc="A Ferrium Part with a wide range of uses.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Steel Part"]={name="Steel Part", tier=3, use="A device part made by processing Steel. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.", desc="A Steel Part with a wide range of uses.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cuprium Part"]={name="Cuprium Part", tier=3, use="A device part made by processing Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.", desc="A Cuprium Part with a wide range of uses.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Hetonite Part"]={name="Hetonite Part", tier=4, use="A device part made by processing Hetonite. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.", desc="A Hetonite Part with a wide range of uses.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Pyrrolite Part"]={name="Pyrrolite Part", tier=4, use="A device part made by processing Pyrrolite. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.", desc="A Pyrrolite Part with a wide range of uses.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	-- Components
	["Amethyst Component"]={name="Amethyst Component", tier=2, use="A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.", desc="The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. Amethyst is the main material used for producing this.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Ferrium Component"]={name="Ferrium Component", tier=2, use="A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.", desc="The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. This mould is mainly made with ferrium for better ejection than the common variant.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cryston Component"]={name="Cryston Component", tier=3, use="A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.", desc="The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. This mould is mainly made with cryston for easier use.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Xiranite Component"]={name="Xiranite Component", tier=4, use="A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.", desc="The full name of this component is a Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Highly Transparent Xiranite Mould. The main materials for constructing this are Packed Origocrust and Xiranite. This mould offers better data transduction when compared to the standard variant.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Cuprium Component"]={name="Cuprium Component", tier=4, use="A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.", desc="The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Xiranite Mould. Cuprium is the main material used for producing this.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Hetonite Component"]={name="Hetonite Component", tier=4, use="A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.", desc="The full name of this component is a Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Xiranite Mould. Hetonite is the main material used for producing this. It also features higher Xiranite capacity than its cuprium counterpart.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Pyrrolite Component"]={name="Pyrrolite Component", tier=4, use="A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.", desc="The full name of this component is a Multifaceted Core-Adaptive Single-Use Xiranite Mould. Pyrrolite is the main material used for producing this. It also features higher Xiranite capacity than its lower tier counterparts.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	-- Bottle variations
	["Amethyst Bottle (Yazhen Solution)"]={name="Amethyst Bottle (Yazhen Solution)", tier=2, use="A bottle made by processing Amethyst Fibers. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Amethyst bottles are being phased out from markets in the Civilization Band due to issues of fragility, weight, and poor Blight resistance.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},

	-- Event items Palm-Top_Savior
	["Experimental Xiranite Bottle"]={name="Experimental Xiranite Bottle", tier=3, use="A container made by processing Xiranite during a special period. 	["Experimental Xiranite Part"]={name="Experimental Xiranite Part", tier=3, use="A part made by processing Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.", desc="This experimental Xiranite part has a rather limited range of applications.", obtain=""},
	["Experimental Heavy Xiranite Bottle"]={name="Experimental Heavy Xiranite Bottle", tier=4, use="A large-capacity container made by processing Heavy Xiranite during a special period. In fact, it is so thick and heavy that people think it could be used as a component for an exotic weapon.", obtain=""},
	["Experimental Heavy Xiranite Part"]={name="Experimental Heavy Xiranite Part", tier=4, use="A part made by processing Heavy Xiranite during a special period. 	["Experimental Xiran-Hue Atomizer"]={name="Experimental Xiran-Hue Atomizer", tier=4, use="A component made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.", desc="A special Xiranite atomizer that can effectively accelerate Xiranite dispersion. Design inspirations are derived from the famous poetry anthology titled Clouds and Sunsets.", obtain=""},
	["Xiranite Gourd"]={name="Xiranite Gourd", tier=4, use="A protective device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be traded at outposts for stock bills as well as Fruits of Altruism Certs.", desc="A special Xiranite-based protective device that looks like an intricate ornament. Nevertheless, if the wearer were to encounter the Blight, this little gadget could spew a fine mist of protective Xiranite particles.\n\"A round-bellied gourd with a pouty snout.\"", obtain=""},
	["Xiranite Jade Gourd"]={name="Xiranite Jade Gourd", tier=5, use="A large-capacity protective device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be traded at outposts for stock bills as well as Fruits of Altruism Certs.", desc="A special Xiranite-based protective device that looks like an intricate ornament. This particular version has a larger Xiranite capacity than the standard variant. If the wearer were to encounter the Blight, this little gadget could spew a fine mist of protective Xiranite particles.\n\"A beautiful gourd that can bail me out.\"", obtain=""},
	["Experimental Heavy Xiranite Bottle"]={name="Experimental Heavy Xiranite Bottle", tier=4, use="A large-capacity container made by processing Heavy Xiranite during a special period.
